07/13.05.2019 Learned counsel for the petitioner undertakes to make necessary correction in the relevant part of I.A. No. 2930 of 2019.
The aforesaid interlocutory application has been filed for extension of interim order dated 20.10.2014 passed by a Bench of this Court in the present petition.

Mr. Shamim Akhtar, learned counsel for the petitioner, submits that the instant Cr.M.P. was filed by the petitioner for quashing the entire criminal case arising out of C-III 239 of 2013 under Sections 51 and 59 (1) read with Section 3(zx) and 3(zz) (v) and (vi) of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006 including the order of cognizance dated 18.07.2013 passed by the learned A.C.J.M., Ranchi in connection with the aforesaid case.

It is further submitted that vide order dated 20.10.2014, a Bench of this Court while admitting the present Cr.M.P., stayed the further proceeding of C-III 239 of 2013 pending in the Court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ranchi, till the disposal of the instant Cr.M.P.

entities.text: Court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: However, the learned A.C.J.M., Ranchi vide order dated 01.03.2019 has observed that the proceeding of the aforesaid complaint case shall continue and accordingly the accused-petitioner has been directed to appear on the next date fixed.

It is also submitted that vide order dated 20.10.2014, a Bench of this Court while appreciating that the present case involves important questions of law, admitted the same for hearing, as such the effect of interim order dated 20.10.2014 may be extended.
Having heard the learned counsel for the petitioner, the learned A.P.P. and considering the fact that a Bench of this Court vide order dated 20.10.2014 admitted this case for hearing and stayed the Pradeep Kumar Modi @ Pradeep Modi vs State Of Jharkhand & Ors. ...
